intent.instructions: Which action should the player take for the next half second to survive and reach the level exit? It is asked several times a second, so pick the single next step, not a plan. Bearings are in degrees relative to where the player faces: negative is left, positive is right. Distances are map units. walls gives the distance to the nearest wall in eight directions; a closed door counts as a wall, and under 48 the player is pressed against it, so walking forward does nothing. route is the way to the exit: head for route.bearing, and route.via says whether the next point is an opening (portal), a door, the exit switch itself, a switch that unlocks the way (press use when use_target is that switch), or a line to walk over (walk). On levels where the exit is not directly reachable the route leads to a key, a switch or a trigger line first; follow it. use_target is what the use action would do right now; it is null when there is nothing to use. A closed door only opens with use, and pressing use again while it is still opening closes it, so after opening a door advance through it. interactables lists nearby doors, switches and the exit; locked means a key the player does not hold. context is the player's memory of this session. explored_areas and area_visits count how many patches of map it has covered and how often it has entered this one; area_visits above 2 means it is going in circles. trail lists where it was seconds_ago, as distance and bearing from here. moved_5s and moved_15s are net units covered; progress_5s and progress_15s are units closer to the exit, and negative means farther away. stuck above 1, or jammed true, means it has been walking without getting anywhere. recent is the last few actions, how far each really moved, and blocked when a walk went nowhere. around: enemies_in_sight, threat (the nearest enemy in sight and closing_per_s, positive when it is coming at the player), damage_3s and damage_10s (health lost lately). summary says the same in words. Use it: never repeat an action that recent shows was blocked, turn to the open side given by walls or strafe instead; when it is going in circles or progress is negative, follow route.bearing and keep away from the trail; when damage is being taken and a threat is closing, deal with the threat before the route.

criteria.advance: Walk forward when route.bearing is within about 15 degrees and walls.ahead is above 48, or to go through a door that has just been opened
criteria.turn_left: Rotate left to face route.bearing, an enemy, or the open side when a wall is dead ahead
criteria.turn_right: Rotate right to face route.bearing, an enemy, or the open side when a wall is dead ahead
criteria.strafe_left: Sidestep left to dodge fire or to slide past a corner or pillar
criteria.strafe_right: Sidestep right to dodge fire or to slide past a corner or pillar
criteria.retreat: Back away from enemies, or toward a health pickup. Never to get past a wall
criteria.use: Press use only when use_target is a closed door that is not locked, or the exit switch. Not when it is null

threat.instructions: Is an enemy likely to damage the player within the next two seconds?

criteria.true: An enemy has line of sight, is within attack range, or is closing in.
criteria.false: No enemy has line of sight, or all are far away and not approaching.

danger.instructions: How dangerous is the player's situation right now?
criteria: Safe: no enemies in view and health above 70
Watchful: enemies in view but far away, health above 50
Engaged: enemies in range, health above 30
Pressured: several enemies in range, or health 30 or below
Critical: health 15 or below with enemies in range
